# Handy Glass & Door LLC

> Local, bilingual (English/Spanish) sliding glass door repair and glass replacement company serving Orlando, Kissimmee and Central Florida, USA. Phone (407) 561-9844 · Sales (407) 379-5085 · info@hgdslidingdoor-repair.com

## Key facts

- Services: sliding glass door repair, roller replacement, track repair, locks and handles, broken glass replacement, foggy (fogged) double-pane glass replacement, sliding door panel and glass replacement in the existing frame, patio door glass repair, commercial glass replacement, office glass partitions, tempered glass and laminated glass.
- Does not install complete new door frames; repairs existing doors and replaces panels or glass within the existing frame.
- Pricing: rollers $65–$89 each depending on the model, plus $175–$200 labor per visit regardless of the number of panels. Glass is quoted after on-site measurement.
- Free on-site estimate; exact price given before any work.
- Phone bookings 24/7 (English and Spanish) at (407) 561-9844 and (407) 379-5085. Appointments Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM.
- Online booking: https://book.hgdslidingdoor-repair.com
- Languages: English and Spanish.
- Service area: Orlando, Kissimmee, Saint Cloud, Davenport, Haines City, Lake Nona, Windermere, Winter Garden, Winter Park, Celebration, Hunters Creek, Dr. Phillips, Apopka, Ocoee, Clermont, Maitland, Poinciana, Buenaventura Lakes and the rest of Central Florida (Orange, Osceola, Polk and Lake counties).
- Google Business Profile: 4.9 stars from 137 reviews — https://www.google.com/maps?cid=4575690264737895589
